summaryZh: Theodorakis研究组以有机合成研究生物学和医学问题，开展天然产物合成与药物发现，以及用于成像和传感的荧光探针设计。研究关注小分子如何调控细胞功能，以及探针如何报告纳米尺度环境和淀粉样蛋白的变化。

如何设计荧光探针以感知细胞环境及区分不同疾病的淀粉样蛋白？
methods: 小分子与天然产物合成
环境响应荧光探针设计

evidence.quote: The Theodorakis group is engaged in the synthesis and study of small molecules that can be used as biological tools to control cellular function and as lead structures for the discovery of new therapeutic agents.
Our current research activities are focused on two topics: (a) the natural products-driven synthesis and drug discovery and (b) the development of fluorescent probes for imaging and sensing.

The Theodorakis group strives to design innovative methods and divergent strategies that generate structural complexity and allow chemical functionalization. Moreover, efforts to translate chemical reactivity of the target molecules to biological properties yield important insights regarding natural products-based biology, mode of action and drug discovery.

The Theodorakis group is engaged in the design of fluorescent probes whose emission profile changes as a function of their environment. Thus, these probes can sense and measure variations of properties such as viscosity and polarity at a nanoscale level.
the Theodorakis group designs probes that target, monitor and colorimetrically discriminate between amyloids of various diseases.
Shipping/Laboratory Location: University of California, San Diego Department of Chemistry
